verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows a model card for each released weight family, but nothing in it says those cards (or any other docs) state per-model input or output token limits. The only context-window figure is a community remark that Llama 3 has an 8k window, which is not first-party documentation. The developer docs also sit behind an SSO wall, and there is no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface to check. With no first-party evidence of precise per-model context and token-budget documentation, this applicable capability is unevidenced.
